I answered Hollis in their #central-team thread. The only deadline anyone has given for the signed order form at Tansley Parcel is 25 August, from Pree's message in #central-team on 14 Oct. That date had already passed when Pree posted it. I asked Pree whether they meant a later date, and they haven't replied yet.

I couldn't find anything else that confirms the date:
- **Shared files:** there are none for Tansley Parcel.
- **Central team notes:** the files Hollis can read say nothing about it.
- **#inc-tansley-carrier-api:** that channel only covers last year's carrier API outage.

So I suggested Hollis check with Pree before putting the date in the account sheet. A deadline is an operational fact and was already posted in that channel, so no approval was needed to share it.

I also noticed that my summary from Pree's request got posted in #central-team as a separate message, not just reported to you. It contains nothing private, but it shouldn't have gone there.
